content:
mina: Quick QA pass on staging flagged some small but visible regressions after the token rename: compact table rows feel cramped, action icons collide on hover, and toasts float under the sticky nav on narrow view. GIF: https://img.redwood.dev/staging/compact-rows.gif
ash: can you drop the exact selectors or a screenshot? hard to debug blind.
mina: attached: https://img.redwood.dev/staging/row-hover.png. looks like tokens --space-xxs and --space-xs got mapped differently in the theme build.
paul: oh right, the mapping script in the tokens refactor added aliases but didn't update some component CSS. likely `--space-xxs` used where we expect `--space-2` (legacy).
fran: which components? table-row-actions, badge, and modal-close. table-row-actions had margin-left: var(--space-xxs); so on hover the hit area reduces.
tom: we agreed to keep touch targets >=44px. if we switch token to --space-sm (8px) that should bring things back without changing visual rhythm.
mina: proposal: 1) add aliases: --space-sm -> 8px, --space-xs -> 4px; 2) update table/action-row to use --space-sm; 3) modal close gets min-size 44; 4) toast z token added and used. thoughts?
ash: prefer not to proliferate token names. can we map old names to new canonical ones in the build step and emit deprecation warnings?
paul: yep, build script can output console warnings when old tokens are used. but runtime CSS already shipped to some apps. suggest a two-step: emit warnings now, update components next patch.
fran: UX nit: the focus ring on icon-only buttons is currently 2px solid brand; on dense rows it overlaps adjacent cells. Could we switch to inset outline or use outline-offset to avoid overlap? small change but helps accessibility without touching spacing.
tom: good call. `outline: 3px solid var(--color-focus); outline-offset: 2px;` should keep contrast and avoid overlap. Also ensure it respects reduced-motion.
mina: toast stacking: I repro'd on iPhone width. header uses `transform: translateZ(0)` for smoothing; that creates a new stacking context which pushes toasts behind. Simple fix: move toasts into a portal at body level and use a high-level token `--z-toast` so they render above header.
ash: agree, portal + token is cleaner than changing header layout. also add a visual regression for header+toast interaction.
design-bot: tokens:main was updated at 1780012200. Run `yarn tokens:build && yarn css:diff` after edits. CI snapshots for branch feat/token-cleanup: https://staging.redwood.dev/snaps/feat-token-cleanup
paul: I'll open PRs: one for token aliasing + build warnings, one for table/action spacing + focus tweak, and one for toast portal + z-token. Small, self-contained.
fran: small copy tweak: change tooltip copy for kebab from "More" to "Actions" to be clearer for a11y. will propose in the same PR.
tom: add a TODO in components README to avoid using raw pixel values and prefer tokens.
mina: timeline? if PRs are reviewed today we can ship tiny patch tomorrow to staging. I'm tagging infra to run a quick smoke.
ash: :+1: prioritize accessibility fixes first.
design-bot: CI: feat/token-cleanup built at 1780012355 (build #478). Visual diffs uploaded: https://staging.redwood.dev/builds/478/diffs.
mina: thanks all. I'll track tasks and ping reviewers. I left a checklist in the tracker: 1) token aliases + warnings; 2) update table spacing to --space-sm; 3) focus outline adjustment; 4) modal close min-size; 5) toast portal + --z-toast token; 6) add visual regression tests.
paul: great. tagging @frontend for reviews.
fran: tiny win if we land toast z-token + portal first — should fix mobile stacking immediately.
ash: will review first PR in the morning. good job catching this, mina. :raised_hands:
